verdict.rationale: Baseten documents several performance features for this story: Truss builds TensorRT-optimized containers and supports vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM engines. It also offers token-by-token streaming over SSE, session-based routing that reuses the KV-cache prefix, "high-performance LLMs" via Model APIs, and a Performance Client for concurrent requests. A community report also says Baseten's server was fast enough that the client became the throughput bottleneck. missing for 10: explicit time-to-first-token or tokens/sec figures or benchmarks, documented latency SLAs or tuning guidance for latency-sensitive workloads, independent hands-on latency measurements.
